correctness.rationale: The fixed equation becomes XU^3-ZV^3 in characteristic three. Differentiation gives the Jacobian complete intersection (U^3,V^3), with degree 9 and genus 10. The explicit map from P(O(-3)⊕O(-1)) ≅ F_2 is finite birational, with Frobenius-degree-three directrix; the affine ring k[t^3,u,tu]⊂k[t,u] has conductor (u,tu)^2=(u,v)^2. Its lines consist of two directrices and the ruling pencil; purely inseparable normalization induces bijections on F_(3^m) points, yielding (3^m+1)^2 and the zeta formula. Independent GF3 projective enumeration found 16 points and 4 points on the singular reduced line. All these are compatible with the fully read earlier Nov2 proof.
residual_risks: Finite GF3 calculation alone does not prove normalization or all extension-field counts; symbolic algebra and published earlier proof support unrestricted statement.
